evidence: Official site bbs.unibo.it confirmed. Global MBA page (bbs.unibo.it/en/global-mba/) confirms exactly 5 tracks matching catalog (AI and Manufacturing; Design, Fashion and Luxury Goods; Food and Wine; Sustainability and Innovation; Supercars, Superbikes and Motorsports), 12 months, English, full-time — accurate. Homepage confirms 'BBS Multicampus' and Villa Guastavillani in the Bolognese hills — campuses accurate. WebSearch (unibo/BBS sources) gives Global MBA tuition EUR 35,000 vs catalog 36,000. Official scholarships page (bbs.unibo.it/en/scholarships-and-honor-loan/) lists full (EUR 27,000) and partial (EUR 15,000) merit scholarships per track + ChefToChef sponsorship; none of the 6 catalog-named scholarships appear there. Accommodation not present on official pages. The legitimate top ~18 program entries (Global MBA, Professional Masters, Executive Master) are credible, but the array is dominated by mislabeled news/event scrape content.
